facts.fact: Pulse Kenya describes the Data Protection Act, 2019 as providing safeguards for personal data, with section 43 requiring controllers to notify the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner within 72 hours of a breach.

Pulse Kenya reports that eCitizen runs OAuth and single sign-on authentication infrastructure that helps connected services verify users, which VECERT raised concerns about possible unauthorised access to; the claim is unconfirmed.
Pulse Kenya says eCitizen's OAuth and single sign-on infrastructure serves connected services, not one system alone.
